meta.name: brand-guidelines
meta.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact that may benefit from having Anthropic's look-and-feel. Use it when brand colors or style guidelines, visual formatting, or company design standards apply.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为作品添加品牌色彩与排版风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为内容快速应用品牌视觉规范。
copy.tagline_en: Apply brand colors and typography to your artifacts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly apply brand visual guidelines to your content.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会把 Anthropic 官方品牌配色和字体套用到你的产出上：标题用 Poppins，正文用 Lora，字体缺失时自动回退 Arial/Georgia，非文字图形轮换橙、蓝、绿三色。
howto.when: 当你涉及品牌配色、视觉排版或公司设计标准时触发，例如做幻灯片或文档时需要符合 Anthropic 的视觉风格。

say.text: 用 Anthropic 的品牌配色和字体做这份幻灯片
say.note: 标题用 Poppins，正文用 Lora

say.text: 把这份文档的标题改成 Poppins、正文改成 Lora
给这些图形用品牌强调色，橙蓝绿依次轮换
say.note: 非文字图形使用强调色

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to what it produces: Poppins headings, Lora body text, automatic Arial/Georgia fallback, and orange, blue and green accents cycled on non-text shapes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when brand colors, visual formatting or company design standards apply, e.g. when a slide or document must follow Anthropic's look-and-feel.

say_en.text: Use Anthropic's brand colors and fonts for this slide deck
Set the headings to Poppins and body text to Lora in this document
say_en.note: Falls back to Arial/Georgia if fonts are missing

say_en.text: Use the brand accents on these shapes, cycling orange, blue, green
